verses.original: מִי־ זֶ֣ה׀ בָּ֣א מֵאֱד֗וֹם מִבָּצְרָ֔ה חֲמ֤וּץ בְּגָדִים֙ זֶ֚ה בִּלְבוּשׁ֔וֹ הָד֣וּר צֹעֶ֖ה בְּרֹ֣ב כֹּח֑וֹ אֲנִ֛י מְדַבֵּ֥ר בִּצְדָקָ֖ה רַ֥ב לְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: mî- zeh bā mê·’ĕ·ḏō·wm mib·bā·ṣə·rāh ḥă·mūṣ bə·ḡā·ḏîm zeh bil·ḇū·šōw hā·ḏūr ṣō·‘eh bə·rōḇ kō·ḥōw ’ă·nî mə·ḏab·bêr biṣ·ḏā·qāh raḇ lə·hō·wō·šî·a‘
verses.literal: Who is this coming from Edom from Bozrah with crimson-stained garments Who is this robed in splendor marching in the greatness of His strength It is I proclaiming vindication mighty to save

verses.original: מַדּ֥וּעַ לִלְבוּשֶׁ֑ךָ אָדֹ֖ם וּבְגָדֶ֖יךָ כְּדֹרֵ֥ךְ בְּגַֽת׃
verses.literal: Why are Your clothes red and Your garments like one who treads the winepress

verses.original: דָּרַ֣כְתִּי פּוּרָ֣ה׀ לְבַדִּ֗י אֵֽין־ אִ֣ישׁ וּמֵֽעַמִּים֙ אִתִּ֔י וְאֶדְרְכֵ֣ם בְּאַפִּ֔י וְאֶרְמְסֵ֖ם בַּחֲמָתִ֑י נִצְחָם֙ עַל־ וְיֵ֤ז בְּגָדַ֔י וְכָל־ מַלְבּוּשַׁ֖י אֶגְאָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: dā·raḵ·tî pū·rāh lə·ḇad·dî ’ên- ’îš ū·mê·‘am·mîm ’it·tî wə·’eḏ·rə·ḵêm bə·’ap·pî wə·’er·mə·sêm ba·ḥă·mā·ṯî niṣ·ḥām ‘al- wə·yêz bə·ḡā·ḏay wə·ḵāl mal·bū·šay ’eḡ·’ā·lə·tî
verses.literal: I have trodden the winepress alone . . . and no one from the nations was with Me I trampled them in My anger and trod them down in My fury their blood . . . spattered My garments and all My clothes were stained

verses.original: כִּ֛י י֥וֹם נָקָ֖ם בְּלִבִּ֑י וּשְׁנַ֥ת גְּאוּלַ֖י בָּֽאָה׃
verses.transliteration: kî yō·wm nā·qām bə·lib·bî ū·šə·naṯ gə·’ū·lay bā·’āh
verses.literal: For the day of vengeance was in My heart and the year of My redemption had come

verses.original: וְאַבִּיט֙ וְאֵ֣ין עֹזֵ֔ר וְאֶשְׁתּוֹמֵ֖ם וְאֵ֣ין סוֹמֵ֑ךְ זְרֹעִ֔י וַתּ֤וֹשַֽׁע לִי֙ וַחֲמָתִ֖י הִ֥יא סְמָכָֽתְנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ab·bîṭ wə·’ên ‘ō·zêr wə·’eš·tō·w·mêm wə·’ên sō·w·mêḵ zə·rō·‘î wat·tō·wō·ša‘ lî wa·ḥă·mā·ṯî hî sə·mā·ḵā·ṯə·nî
verses.literal: I looked but there was no one to help I was appalled that no one assisted So My arm brought Me salvation . . . and My own wrath . . . upheld Me

verses.original: וְאָב֤וּס עַמִּים֙ בְּאַפִּ֔י בַּחֲמָתִ֑י וַאֲשַׁכְּרֵ֖ם וְאוֹרִ֥יד נִצְחָֽם׃ס לָאָ֖רֶץ
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·ḇūs ‘am·mîm bə·’ap·pî ba·ḥă·mā·ṯî wa·’ă·šak·kə·rêm wə·’ō·w·rîḏ niṣ·ḥām lā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: I trampled the nations in My anger in My wrath I made them drunk and poured out their blood on the ground

verses.original: אַזְכִּיר֙ יְהוָ֤ה׀ חַֽסְדֵ֨י יְהוָ֔ה תְּהִלֹּ֣ת כְּעַ֕ל כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֑ה גְּמָלָ֖נוּ וְרַב־ טוּב֙ לְבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־ גְּמָלָ֥ם כְּֽרַחֲמָ֖יו וּכְרֹ֥ב חֲסָדָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’az·kîr Yah·weh ḥas·ḏê Yah·weh tə·hil·lōṯ kə·‘al kōl ’ă·šer- Yah·weh gə·mā·lā·nū wə·raḇ- ṭūḇ lə·ḇêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer- gə·mā·lām kə·ra·ḥă·māw ū·ḵə·rōḇ ḥă·sā·ḏāw
verses.literal: I will make known the LORD’s loving devotion and [His] praiseworthy acts because of all that the LORD has done for us the many good things for the house of Israel - - according to His great compassion [and] loving devotion

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הֵ֔מָּה אַךְ־ עַמִּ֣י בָּנִ֖ים לֹ֣א יְשַׁקֵּ֑רוּ וַיְהִ֥י לָהֶ֖ם לְמוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hêm·māh ’aḵ- ‘am·mî bā·nîm lō yə·šaq·qê·rū way·hî lā·hem lə·mō·wō·šî·a‘
verses.literal: For He said They are surely My people sons who will not be disloyal So He became their Savior

verses.original: בְּֽכָל־ צָרָתָ֣ם׀ לֹא צָ֗ר וּמַלְאַ֤ךְ פָּנָיו֙ הֽוֹשִׁיעָ֔ם בְּאַהֲבָת֥וֹ וּבְחֶמְלָת֖וֹ ה֣וּא גְאָלָ֑ם וַֽיְנַטְּלֵ֥ם וַֽיְנַשְּׂאֵ֖ם כָּל־ יְמֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵāl ṣā·rā·ṯām lō ṣār ū·mal·’aḵ pā·nāw hō·wō·šî·‘ām bə·’a·hă·ḇā·ṯōw ū·ḇə·ḥem·lā·ṯōw hū ḡə·’ā·lām way·naṭ·ṭə·lêm way·naś·śə·’êm kāl- yə·mê ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: In all their distress . . . He too was afflicted and the Angel of His Presence saved them In His love and compassion He redeemed them He lifted them up and carried them all the days of old

verses.original: וְהֵ֛מָּה מָר֥וּ וְעִצְּב֖וּ אֶת־ קָדְשׁ֑וֹ ר֣וּחַ וַיֵּהָפֵ֥ךְ לָהֶ֛ם לְאוֹיֵ֖ב ה֥וּא נִלְחַם־ בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hêm·māh mā·rū wə·‘iṣ·ṣə·ḇū ’eṯ- qā·ḏə·šōw rū·aḥ way·yê·hā·p̄êḵ lā·hem lə·’ō·w·yêḇ hū nil·ḥam- bām
verses.literal: But they rebelled and grieved - His Holy Spirit So He turned [and became] their enemy [and] He Himself fought against them

verses.original: עַמּ֑וֹ וַיִּזְכֹּ֥ר יְמֵֽי־ עוֹלָ֖ם מֹשֶׁ֣ה אַיֵּ֣ה׀ הַֽמַּעֲלֵ֣ם מִיָּ֗ם אֵ֚ת רֹעֵ֣י צֹאנ֔וֹ אַיֵּ֛ה הַשָּׂ֥ם קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃ ר֥וּחַ בְּקִרְבּ֖וֹ אֶת־
verses.transliteration: ‘am·mōw way·yiz·kōr yə·mê- ‘ō·w·lām mō·šeh ’ay·yêh ham·ma·‘ă·lêm mî·yām ’êṯ rō·‘ê ṣō·nōw ’ay·yêh haś·śām qā·ḏə·šōw rū·aḥ bə·qir·bōw ’eṯ-
verses.literal: Then His people remembered the days of old the days of Moses Where is He who brought them through the sea with the shepherds of His flock Where is the One who set His Holy Spirit among them

verses.original: מוֹלִיךְ֙ תִּפְאַרְתּ֑וֹ זְר֖וֹעַ לִימִ֣ין מֹשֶׁ֔ה בּ֤וֹקֵֽעַ מַ֙יִם֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת ל֖וֹ עוֹלָֽם׃ שֵׁ֥ם
verses.transliteration: mō·w·lîḵ tip̄·’ar·tōw zə·rō·w·a‘ lî·mîn mō·šeh bō·w·qê·a‘ ma·yim mip·pə·nê·hem la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lōw ‘ō·w·lām šêm
verses.literal: who sent His glorious arm [to lead them] by the right hand of Moses who divided the waters before them to gain for Himself everlasting renown

verses.original: מוֹלִיכָ֖ם בַּתְּהֹמ֑וֹת כַּסּ֥וּס בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר לֹ֥א יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mō·w·lî·ḵām bat·tə·hō·mō·wṯ kas·sūs bam·miḏ·bār lō yik·kā·šê·lū
verses.literal: who led them through the depths like a horse in the wilderness so that they did not stumble

verses.original: כַּבְּהֵמָה֙ תֵרֵ֔ד בַּבִּקְעָ֣ה ר֥וּחַ יְהוָ֖ה תְּנִיחֶ֑נּוּ נִהַ֣גְתָּ עַמְּךָ֔ כֵּ֚ן לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לְךָ֖ תִּפְאָֽרֶת׃ שֵׁ֥ם
verses.transliteration: kab·bə·hê·māh ṯê·rêḏ bab·biq·‘āh rū·aḥ Yah·weh tə·nî·ḥen·nū ni·haḡ·tā ‘am·mə·ḵā kên la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lə·ḵā tip̄·’ā·reṯ šêm
verses.literal: Like cattle going down to the valley the Spirit of the LORD gave them rest You led Your people this way to make for Yourself a glorious name

verses.original: הַבֵּ֤ט מִשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וּרְאֵ֔ה קָדְשְׁךָ֖ וְתִפְאַרְתֶּ֑ךָ מִזְּבֻ֥ל אַיֵּ֤ה קִנְאָֽתְךָ֙ וּגְב֣וּרֹתֶ֔ךָ הֲמ֥וֹן מֵעֶ֛יךָ וְֽרַחֲמֶ֖יךָ אֵלַ֥י הִתְאַפָּֽקוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hab·bêṭ miš·šā·ma·yim ū·rə·’êh qāḏ·šə·ḵā wə·ṯip̄·’ar·te·ḵā miz·zə·ḇul ’ay·yêh qin·’ā·ṯə·ḵā ū·ḡə·ḇū·rō·ṯe·ḵā hă·mō·wn mê·‘e·ḵā wə·ra·ḥă·me·ḵā ’ê·lay hiṯ·’ap·pā·qū
verses.literal: Look down from heaven and see from Your holy and glorious habitation Where are Your zeal and might Your yearning . . . and compassion for me are restrained

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֣ה אָבִ֔ינוּ כִּ֤י אַבְרָהָם֙ לֹ֣א יְדָעָ֔נוּ וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֣א יַכִּירָ֑נוּ אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אָבִ֔ינוּ גֹּאֲלֵ֥נוּ מֵֽעוֹלָ֖ם שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh ’ā·ḇî·nū kî ’aḇ·rā·hām lō yə·ḏā·‘ā·nū wə·yiś·rā·’êl lō yak·kî·rā·nū ’at·tāh Yah·weh ’ā·ḇî·nū gō·’ă·lê·nū mê·‘ō·w·lām šə·me·ḵā
verses.literal: Yet You are our Father though Abraham does not know us and Israel does not acknowledge us You O LORD are our Father our Redeemer from Everlasting is Your name

verses.original: לָ֣מָּה יְהוָה֙ תַתְעֵ֤נוּ מִדְּרָכֶ֔יךָ תַּקְשִׁ֥יחַ לִבֵּ֖נוּ מִיִּרְאָתֶ֑ךָ שׁ֚וּב לְמַ֣עַן עֲבָדֶ֔יךָ שִׁבְטֵ֖י נַחֲלָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh Yah·weh ṯaṯ·‘ê·nū mid·də·rā·ḵe·ḵā taq·šî·aḥ lib·bê·nū mî·yir·’ā·ṯe·ḵā šûb̲ lə·ma·‘an ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā šiḇ·ṭê na·ḥă·lā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Why O LORD do You make us stray from Your ways [and] harden our hearts from fearing You Return for the sake of Your servants the tribes of Your heritage

verses.original: לַמִּצְעָ֕ר עַם־ יָרְשׁ֖וּ קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ צָרֵ֕ינוּ בּוֹסְס֖וּ מִקְדָּשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lam·miṣ·‘ār ‘am- yā·rə·šū qāḏ·še·ḵā ṣā·rê·nū bō·ws·sū miq·dā·še·ḵā
verses.literal: For a short while Your people possessed Your holy place but our enemies have trampled Your sanctuary

verses.original: הָיִ֗ינוּ מֵֽעוֹלָם֙ לֹֽא־ מָשַׁ֣לְתָּ בָּ֔ם לֹֽא־ נִקְרָ֥א שִׁמְךָ֖ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם
verses.transliteration: hā·yî·nū mê·‘ō·w·lām lō- mā·šal·tā bām lō- niq·rā šim·ḵā ‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: We have become like those You never . . . ruled like those not called by Your name . . .
